$comment: The Variable-Mu Limiter's parameters, declared once.
Both the C++ setter dispatch and the TypeScript control table are GENERATED
from this file by scripts/generate-params.mjs. Neither is hand-written and
neither may be hand-edited — that is what makes Ledger cell D1's first half
EVERY CHANNEL CONTROL APPEARS TWICE, and that is §3.5 and §3.7 rather than a
generalisation. The stereo unit is two complete channel strips and the sheet
says in as many words that a user setting a different threshold and a
different time constant for the lateral and the vertical path is the reason
the unit is still on mix buses. One set of controls driving both channels
reproduces the matrix correctly and still cannot do the thing the matrix is
The channels are named for both modes because they are genuinely different
signals in each: in left/right they are the two speakers, in lateral/vertical
they are the sum and the difference.
Two controls have reversed panel sense, and both are deliberate — §3.2 and
§3.1. The threshold reads 10 for no compression, and the input control is an
attenuator whose panel reads 20 down to 0. An emulation that quietly corrects
either is wrong in a way that feels right.

params.name: Input A
params.note: A stepped attenuator on the hardware, 1 dB per step across 20 dB, with no gain anywhere on it. It is the drive control: the threshold is set separately, so this decides how hard the tube is worked for a given amount of reduction.

params.name: Input B
params.note: A stepped attenuator on the hardware, 1 dB per step across 20 dB, with no gain anywhere on it. It is the drive control: the threshold is set separately, so this decides how hard the tube is worked for a given amount of reduction.

params.name: Threshold A
params.accessibleName: Left / Lateral threshold, ten is no compression
params.note: Reversed sense, §3.2. Ten fully clockwise is no compression and zero is maximum, which is the panel and not a mistake.

params.name: Threshold B
params.accessibleName: Right / Vertical threshold, ten is no compression
params.note: Reversed sense, §3.2. Ten fully clockwise is no compression and zero is maximum, which is the panel and not a mistake.

params.name: Time Constant A
params.note: The control is a choice index and the panel counts from one, so the +1 is the mapping. Positions 5 and 6 are programme-dependent — see §4.

params.name: Time Constant B
params.note: The control is a choice index and the panel counts from one, so the +1 is the mapping. Positions 5 and 6 are programme-dependent — see §4.

params.name: DC Threshold A
params.note: A rear trim on the hardware, exposed because without it the published 2:1 to 30:1 ratio range is unreachable. Secondary, with a calibrated default.

params.name: DC Threshold B
params.note: A rear trim on the hardware, exposed because without it the published 2:1 to 30:1 ratio range is unreachable. Secondary, with a calibrated default.

params.name: Mode
params.note: The matrix is formed in the transformer windings, so it is a mode of the audio path rather than a routing option around it.
